summary: IBEX Limited filed a Form 8-K on September 10, 2026 disclosing entry into amendments to its U.S. and UAE credit agreements, dated September 8, 2026. Amendment No. 1 to the HSBC-administered U.S. Credit Agreement extends the maturity date to October 22, 2029, adds a 0.20% closing fee on the $25 million secured revolver, and imposes a 0.30% annual commitment fee on unused capacity. The UAE facility with HSBC Bank Middle East also extends maturity to October 22, 2029, adds a $1 million performance bond, and maintains the $50 million post-shipment seller revolving loan. No special-situation event is present.
